title: 第二十四章 弃子绝生路，暗潮覆京畿
content_zh:
相府布防彻底敲定时，日头已然爬高。

    摄政王府的暗卫悄无声息遍布相府内外，墙头、巷尾、后门僻静处皆有人隐守，气息沉敛，不露分毫痕迹。寻常下人只觉府中比往日更肃穆安稳，无人知晓，一张严密的防护网已然彻底铺开，只为护住汀兰院一人。

    沈清鸢将那枚墨玉玉佩妥帖收进贴身锦袋，指尖轻轻抚过衣襟，心底清明透彻。

    暗阁蛰伏数十年，步步隐忍，绝不可能仅仅为了一枚玉佩贸然出世。

    玉佩是引，背后藏着的，怕是牵扯数十年前的旧朝秘辛。

    萧聿辞立在她身侧，眸色沉淡，低声叮嘱：“接下来几日京城不会太平，你安心待在府中，切勿轻易外出。所有来路不明的人与信，一概不见、不收、不理。”

    他语气温和，却带着不容置喙的稳妥。

    沈清鸢轻轻点头：“我晓得。柳氏一死，暗阁便彻底断了前尘线索，接下来，该主动找我们了。”

    话音刚落，外院暗卫神色急匆，大步入院跪地禀报，声音带着几分凝重。

    “王爷、大小姐！盘山驿道急报！流放队伍昨夜深夜遇袭，黑衣人身手利落，专攻柳氏一人，一击得手即刻退走，全程不伤及官差、不抢夺犯人，只为灭口！”

    “柳氏……已然殒命。”

    一语落下，院内瞬间静了几分。

    沈清鸢眼底无半分意外。

    暗阁最擅长弃子灭口。

    柳氏数十年棋子生涯，如今用处耗尽，暴露踪迹，留着只会招惹麻烦、泄露机密，暗阁绝不会留她活口。

    “死前可有留下只言片语？”沈清鸢沉声追问。

    暗卫垂首回话：“看守官差传回，柳氏弥留之际回光返照，只死死攥着掌心，反复念了半句——‘玉非宝，血为根……错守半生’，随后便气绝身亡。”

    玉非宝，血为根。

    短短六字，炸开所有迷雾的边角。

    沈清鸢心头巨震，瞬间通透。

    原来暗阁贪图的从来不是玉佩本身！
content_en:
When the defense deployment of the Prime Minister's Mansion was completely finalized, the sun was already rising.

The secret guards of the Prince Regent's Palace were silently present inside and outside the Prime Minister's Palace. There were people guarding the walls, at the end of alleys, and in secluded places at the back door. Their auras were calm and no traces were revealed.Ordinary servants only feel that the mansion is more solemn and stable than before. No one knows that a tight protective net has been completely rolled out to protect only one person in Tinglan Courtyard.

Shen Qingyuan put the black jade pendant securely into the brocade bag close to his body, and gently stroked the skirt of his clothes with his fingertips, feeling clear and clear in his heart.

An Pavilion has been dormant for decades and has been forbearing step by step. It is absolutely impossible for him to emerge rashly just for a jade pendant.

The jade pendant is a guide, and what is hidden behind it may involve secrets from the old dynasty decades ago.

Xiao Yuci stood beside her, his eyes were dull, and he whispered: "The capital will not be peaceful in the next few days. You can stay in the house with peace of mind and do not go out easily. All people and letters from unknown sources will not be seen, accepted, or ignored."

His tone was gentle, but with an undeniable certainty.

Shen Qingyuan nodded slightly: "I know. As soon as Mrs. Liu died, Ange completely cut off the traces of its past. Next, it's time to take the initiative to find us."

As soon as he finished speaking, the secret guard in the outer courtyard looked anxious, strode into the hospital, knelt down and reported, his voice a bit solemn.

"Your Majesty, Miss! An urgent report from the Panshan Post Road! The exile team was attacked late last night. The man in black was very agile and focused on the Liu family. He immediately retreated after a successful attack. He did not hurt the officials or rob the prisoners throughout the whole process, just to silence them!"

"Liu...is dead."

As soon as he finished speaking, the courtyard became silent for a moment.

There was no surprise in Shen Qingyuan's eyes.

Ange is best at abandoning children and silencing them.

Liu's decades-long career as a chess piece has now exhausted its usefulness and exposed her traces. Keeping her will only cause trouble and leak secrets. The secret cabinet will never let her live.

"Did you leave a few words before you died?" Shen Qingyuan asked in a deep voice.

The secret guard bowed his head and replied: "The guard sent a message back. When Mrs. Liu was dying, she just clenched her palms and recited half a sentence repeatedly - 'Jade is not a treasure, blood is the root... I have been missing for half my life.' Then she died."

Jade is not a treasure, blood is its root.

In just six words, all the corners of the fog are blown away.

Shen Qingyuan's heart was shocked and suddenly clear.

It turns out that what Ange was after was never the jade pendant itself!
